stage0028_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$オードリー$$
（It's been almost a month since I came aboard this ship...）

stage0028_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$オードリー$$
（Neo Zeon shows no sign of movement, but
　did my disappearance cause turmoil there...）

stage0028_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$オードリー$$
（And what... do I intend to do here...）

stage0028_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Is that all right, $$バナージ$$?
　$$オードリー$$'s moping over there.」

stage0028_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If there were something I could do, I'd have done it already.」

stage0028_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Don't just give up like that.
　If you don't know what to do,
　try asking us for advice.」

stage0028_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Listen to you, $$デュオ$$.
　You sound like a pro at women's hearts.」

stage0028_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Nah, nah...
　I'm not the one to rely on for this.
　The real master's standing right here.」

stage0028_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「$$ヒイロ$$, a master of women's hearts!?」

stage0028_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I really can't picture that...」

stage0028_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Nah, nah, but here's the thing...
　this guy's out of nowhere remarks
　seem to really draw women in.」

stage0028_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Impact and surprise, that's what works on women.
　Ripping up an invitation handed to you,
　or dropping a killer line out of nowhere...」

stage0028_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Exactly what it sounds like.
　Like, 'I will kill you.'」

stage0028_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「That's not something I can let slide.
　Explain yourself, $$ヒイロ$$.」

stage0028_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Even the Fire-Quenching Wind turns into
　just a big brother where Miss $$リリーナ$$'s concerned.」

stage0028_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ノイン$$
「He must have been provoked by that boy $$カイエン$$
　during the last battle in $$アクエリア市$$.」

stage0028_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
（You covered that up by bulling through, $$ゼクス$$.
　That's not like you...）

stage0028_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「A woman's heart is delicate.
　You mustn't lean on the fantasy that your hearts
　stay connected even while apart.」

stage0028_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ノイン$$
「Coming from you, that carries no weight.」

stage0028_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ノイン$$
「Isn't your codename Wind supposed to mean
　a drifter, free as the breeze?」

stage0028_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
（$$ノイン$$... seems like she's been holding in
　quite a bit of stress deep down...）

stage0028_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アムロ$$
「the wind that smothers fires,
　and today he got fanned into a blaze himself.」

stage0028_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$リディ$$
「Well, since $$バナージ$$ seems to be hesitating,
　I'll be the one to ease $$オードリー$$'s heart.」

stage0028_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$リディ$$
「I know more about women's hearts than I look.
　At least more than that $$ヒイロ$$ over there.」

stage0028_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That's a pretty low bar to clear, Ensign.」

stage0028_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't say that, $$デュオ$$.
　The Ensign's playing the fool on purpose
　just to light a fire under $$バナージ$$.」

stage0028_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...$n, $$オードリー$$!
　Got a minute?」

stage0028_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Let $$カミーユ$$ and the others join in
　tomorrow's Volunteer Club activities.」

stage0028_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$n
「Understood.
　More hands means more help, so they're welcome.」

stage0028_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（There, $$バナージ$$...
　Captain $$アムロ$$ went out of his way to help.
　Don't let his kindness go to waste.）

stage0028_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$... let's go help out too.
　With everyone from the Volunteer Club there,
　I'm sure it'll be fun.」

stage0028_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$n
「No... you just caught me off guard.」

stage0028_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$バナージ$$
「See, $$オードリー$$.
　Even $$ヒイロ$$ says he's coming along.」

stage0028_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$オードリー$$
「...All right, $$バナージ$$.
　I'll come along too.」

stage0028_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Go get some fresh air, it'll do you good.
　I'll have a word with $$アルベルト$$ myself.」

stage0028_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（There it is again...
　$$オードリー$$ stiffens up whenever
　Captain $$アムロ$$ speaks to her...）

stage0028_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$n
（Why does this girl...
　look at Captain $$アムロ$$ like that...）

stage0028_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$アンディ$$
「...Here it is a perfectly good Sunday,
　and we're stuck cleaning the school...」

stage0028_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Straighten up, $$アンディ$$!
　You're a disgrace to the Elements!」

stage0028_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Don't give me that!
　I didn't sign up to pilot Aquarion
　just to do cleaning duty!」

stage0028_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「That goes for everyone else too.
　...But once we're in this world,
　we follow this world's rules!」

stage0028_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Don't come near me, you two-timer!
　Disgusting!」

stage0028_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$n
「Calm down, $$アルト$$.
　What's the club president doing starting fights first?」

stage0028_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$甲児$$
「The vice president's right.
　The point of today's cleanup is to bring us
　and the Elements closer together.」

stage0028_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Yeah, right, isn't the real reason
　you just needed more hands?」

stage0028_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Uh, uhahahaha!
　That's not it at all!」

stage0028_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Come on, it's fine.
　Since we're here, let's make friends
　with everyone from this world too.」

stage0028_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$サザンカ$$
（Every which way I look, gorgeous guys and cuties!
　Thank you, God, for this meeting!）

stage0028_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「$$サザンカ$$... there's that bad habit again...」

stage0028_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Don't worry about it, don't worry about it!
　Come on, let's get pumped and clean!」

stage0028_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Pointless...
　If we've got time to waste on this,
　we'd be better off training at base.」

stage0028_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$シン$$
「Not really.
　Refreshing your mind like this matters too.」

stage0028_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Who are you supposed to be?」

stage0028_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
Shinn
「I introduced myself when we all met, remember?
　I'm $$シン・アスカ$$.
　Good to know you, $$カイエン$$.」

stage0028_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I don't care for overly familiar men.」

stage0028_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$シン$$
「Don't be like that.
　We're comrades now, so let's get along.」

stage0028_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$シン$$... seems like you've taken
　a liking to that $$カイエン$$ guy.」

stage0028_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ゼクス$$ isn't the only one who felt for him
　wanting to protect his sister.」

stage0028_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Does he have a sister too?」

stage0028_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I never told you, so of course you wouldn't know.
　Don't worry about it, $$オードリー$$.」

stage0028_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That feeling is where $$シン$$'s fight began.
　He's trying to end the war so no one else
　suffers what his sister did.」

stage0028_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If $$シン$$'s the one who felt for $$カイエン$$,
　then $$バナージ$$'s the other type.」

stage0028_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Let's do our best, $$ミコノ$$.」

stage0028_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm used to cleaning from my theater job.」

stage0028_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Actually, it's because I'm with $$ミコノ$$.）

stage0028_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Then, $$アマタ$$...
　why don't you clean paired with me?」

stage0028_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「You and I are the starting lineup for sorties.
　We need to stay in sync off the field too.」

stage0028_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But then, doesn't that mean $$カイエン$$ too...?」

stage0028_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$カイエン$$'s fine.
　He's getting along great with that kid, $$シン$$.」

stage0028_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「You're getting way too close to $$アマタ$$, $$ゼシカ$$!」

stage0028_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Ah, w-when you press against me like that...!」

stage0028_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Hahaha!
　Guess I got your heart racing!」

stage0028_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Ow, ow...
　I can't believe you just tackled me like that...」

stage0028_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Sorry...!
　That was a bit rough!」

stage0028_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I-I'm fine...
　Thanks to you, I'm saved.」

stage0028_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Thanks.
　Um... it's $$バナージ$$, right?」

stage0028_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You're $$アマタ$$, right?
　Nice to meet you, going forward.」

stage0028_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Alright, everyone!
　Time to gather up!」

stage0028_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$大貫$$'s got the work explanation.
　Listen up, all of you!」

stage0028_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$大貫$$
「I'm $$大貫$$, the caretaker.
　I'm glad all of you
　came out on a day off like this.」

stage0028_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$アンディ$$
「More like we got dragged here by force, though.」

stage0028_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$アマタ$$
（That guy's got some serious presence...）

stage0028_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$バナージ$$
（But normally he's just the school caretaker...）

stage0028_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$大貫$$
「Now then, everyone...
　split into your groups and get to work.」

stage0028_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$大貫$$
「Once the work's done,
　it's nothing fancy, but I'll have dinner ready,
　so please stay and eat.」

stage0028_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Everyone, dismissed!
　Get to your posts, now!」

stage0028_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Alright!
　Leave the trash hole to my Digging power!」

stage0028_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I'll patch the outer wall cracks with my Space Fill.」

stage0028_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Then I'll rot the food waste with my Corrosion.」

stage0028_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Element powers
　are surprisingly useful for cleaning, huh...」

stage0028_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Hey, $$アマタ$$!
　You, $$ミコノ$$, and $$ゼシカ$$ have the 4th floor windows!」

stage0028_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Keep that up for the windows too, okay?」

stage0028_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Honestly, $$アマタ$$!
　You go all mushy the second you see a cute girl!」

stage0028_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「No time to be mad, $$ミコノ$$!
　We need to back $$アマタ$$ up.」

stage0028_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Come on, shorter skirt, more neckline!
　If his heart's not racing, $$アマタ$$'ll fall!」

stage0028_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$アマタ$$
（That bashful face is too much!!）

stage0028_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah, yeah, right tool for the job.」

stage0028_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$n
「So I'm grouped with $$カミーユ$$ and $$ファ$$,
　$$宗介$$, and Chidori, huh.」

stage0028_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$'s supervising the work
　together with $$竜馬$$, apparently.」

stage0028_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh, come on...!
　Aren't you curious about her and $$竜馬$$?」

stage0028_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ファ$$
「Now that you mention it, those two...
　talk a lot together back at the unit too.」

stage0028_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Isn't that just Miss $$スズネ$$
　consulting him on handling problem kids?」

stage0028_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$n
「Being called the problem child stings.
　Let's just go clean already.」

stage0028_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$かなめ$$
（A little annoyed...
　I was just teasing, but maybe it's serious...）

stage0028_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
???
（Found them.
　So those are $$相良宗介$$ and the Volunteer Club.）

stage0028_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
???
（Good opportunity.
　I'll settle this here, today.）

stage0028_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Okay, once we finish waxing this corridor,
　we'll head to the 3rd floor next.」

stage0028_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Hold on a second.
　Isn't this way too much work?」

stage0028_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's what your $$ブーストアップ$$ is for, $n...
　zip through it, quick as that!」

stage0028_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$宗介$$
「How sloppy, $n.
　Make it work in those 10 seconds.」

stage0028_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ワッフル$$
「If you don't want to clean that badly...」

stage0028_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ショコラ$$
「then you'll keep us company instead.」

stage0028_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$かなめ$$
「These three are from the Karate Club.
　I just call them $$マロン$$, $$ワッフル$$,
　and $$ショコラ$$ on my own, though...」

stage0028_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$マロン$$
「$$千鳥かなめ$$...
　Give me a favorable answer already.」

stage0028_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Listen!
　I already turned that down flat!」

stage0028_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...While Sousuke and the others were out
　on activities, on President $$林水$$'s orders,
　I told them to vacate the shack they squat in...」

stage0028_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Ever since that day, to me...」

stage0028_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「They're telling me to be their manager.」

stage0028_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$マロン$$
「A girl manager is a club's shining flower...!」

stage0028_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ワッフル$$
「Look closely, she's got quite a cute face too...!」

stage0028_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ショコラ$$
「If she'd prepare honey lemon slices
　and towels for us...!」

stage0028_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$n
「So basically, unpopular guys venting their spite...」

stage0028_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$マロン$$
「We are warriors...
　We never meant to win with words.」

stage0028_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ワッフル$$
「Perfectly three on three...
　One kill each, then.」

stage0028_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop it!
　Trying to solve things through violence,
　that's no different from war!」

stage0028_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$マロン$$
「Coward.
　Seems you've lost your nerve.」

stage0028_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Whatever you say, I won't accept a method like this!」

stage0028_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ワッフル$$
「So you insist on refusing to fight?」

stage0028_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ショコラ$$
「Very well, pretty boy.
　I respect your ideals, but I'll take this as a win.」

stage0028_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ショコラ$$
「I won't forget a man like you.
　Tell me your name.」

stage0028_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ショコラ$$
「$$カミーユ$$?
　That's a woman's name...」

stage0028_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What's wrong with $$カミーユ$$ being a man's name!」

stage0028_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So $$カミーユ$$'s got
　a complex about his name...」

stage0028_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ファ$$
「$$カミーユ$$!
　Have you forgotten that's exactly why
　you joined the $$エゥーゴ$$!?」

stage0028_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「An unexpected truth comes to light!」

stage0028_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Keep this a secret from $$シン$$.」

stage0028_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ワッフル$$
「Ngh!
　Then I'll deal with that shifty-eyed man!」

stage0028_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$n
「I won't use my boost...
　Out of respect for your devotion
　to martial arts, I fought you fair.」

stage0028_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$n
「Hunting, and this move too,
　Dad drilled into me till I was sick of it.」

stage0028_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ワッフル$$
「Don't say I never warned you...!
　Let me say this first!
　What we seek is true Vale Tudo!」

stage0028_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ワッフル$$
「In ultra-practical mixed martial arts,
　be ready to lose a bone or two...!」

stage0028_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's MY line!
　Using a ranged weapon is way too far!」

stage0028_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$宗介$$
「It's a rubber-bullet gun.
　No threat to life.」

stage0028_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$宗介$$
「Isn't using superior equipment
　standard practice in real combat!」

stage0028_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
???
「...Seems he's an even bigger mess than I'd heard.」

stage0028_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「He's the karate club president, by the way.」

stage0028_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$宗介$$
「So you're the ringleader threatening Chidori.」

stage0028_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Issei!
　I've told you again and again,
　I won't be the karate club's manager!」

stage0028_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$一成$$
「Uh... well...!
　If you hate it that much, I won't force it...
　but, um... ha... hahaha.」

stage0028_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ファ$$
（What's with that guy...?
　Bold or timid, I can't quite tell...）

stage0028_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（He's serious about wanting her as manager,
　but he seems more innocent than I thought.）

stage0028_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$宗介$$
「That's enough, Tsubaki.
　I'll remove this obstacle to Chidori.」

stage0028_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$一成$$
「A showdown with you is just what I wanted.
　Once you and the Volunteer Club are gone,
　Chidori will have free time and take the job...」

stage0028_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm... not exactly Sousuke's babysitter, but...」

stage0028_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$一成$$
「Anyway!
　It's a duel for my friends' honor and Chidori!」

stage0028_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$宗介$$
「Seems the custom in this case
　is to fight bare-handed. Fine, I'll adapt.」

stage0028_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$一成$$
「But you'll soon wish
　you'd used your gun instead!」

stage0028_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$一成$$
「Daidoumyaku Style Secret Art: Blood Clot Palm!」

stage0028_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$n
「It focuses power stored in the body's coil
　into the palm, then strikes in one blow...!
　It can shatter solid rock if you're not careful!」

stage0028_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Um... this is turning into
　a completely different genre...」

stage0028_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$宗介$$
「Stay back, Chidori...!
　This fight isn't over yet!」

stage0028_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$一成$$
「Hoh... shifting your body's axis
　right at impact. You're no ordinary fighter.」

stage0028_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I told you to clean up!
　Why are you making a mess instead!?」

stage0028_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$一成$$
「Stay out of this!
　This is a duel of pride between men!」

stage0028_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Big talk, standing in front of me.」

stage0028_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Show it to me first, before $$宗介$$.
　That pride of yours.」

stage0028_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Issei's being overwhelmed by his presence...」

stage0028_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Gone quiet, huh...
　Guess I'll make the first move then.」

stage0028_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$大貫$$
「What do you think you're doing, Nagare!」

stage0028_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$大貫$$
「Honestly...!
　A grown man brawling with students!
　Have you no sense as caretaker at all!」

stage0028_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$大貫$$
「And what about those ones knocked out over there?」

stage0028_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Those guys are trespassers who broke into school...」

stage0028_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$大貫$$
「I'm not complaining that you drove off intruders!
　I'm saying you left them lying in the corridor!」

stage0028_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$大貫$$
「If a big guy like that's lying around,
　anyone passing by would be startled!」

stage0028_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$大貫$$
「Ah... things were better in the old days.
　The young were pure, full of dreams and hope...
　Poor in goods, but rich in heart...」

stage0028_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$大貫$$
「And now, look at it.
　Those students dueling over there, same thing...
　Rich in goods, but hearts have grown coarse...」

stage0028_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$大貫$$
「I'm a bit tired...
　I'll rest in the infirmary till the cleanup's done.」

stage0028_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$竜馬$$
「...You two, help carry off that trio
　and the $$ファイヤバグ$$ guys.」

stage0028_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's surprising, though...
　$$竜馬$$ actually listens to $$大貫$$, huh.」

stage0028_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Some things are better left unknown.」

stage0028_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$甲児$$
「This is bad, everyone!
　$$ファイヤバグ$$'s coming!」

stage0028_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Tch! The ones I flattened were just scouts!」

stage0028_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$甲児$$
「We'd better hurry, or the sun's going to set...」

stage0028_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$アルト$$
「But what do we do?
　Never mind sleeping $$大貫$$,
　Tsubaki's probably onto us now」

stage0028_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$n
「I get you're happy $$ボン太くん#robot$$ did great,
　but hurry up and take that thing off already」

stage0028_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$一成$$
「$$相良宗介$$!
　Are you there!?」

stage0028_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$一成$$
「Argh!
　If I can't tell, I'll just hit anything nearby!」

stage0028_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$さやか$$
「Hey, $$かなめ$$!
　Isn't knocking him out a bit much!?」

stage0028_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$かなめ$$
「To protect the Volunteer Club's secret,
　it couldn't be helped」

stage0028_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$カレン$$
「This one right here, $$ボン太くん#robot$$,
　he didn't seem to notice at all...」

stage0028_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$n
「More than that, he couldn't even tell us apart」

stage0028_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$甲児$$
「Those are some serious coke-bottle glasses!」

stage0028_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Tsubaki's eyesight is actually terrible.
　But he skips his glasses to look cool」

stage0028_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't think he saw Sousuke
　putting on $$ボン太くん#robot$$, or $n
　calling out $$ジェニオン$$」

stage0028_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$カレン$$
「Then if we all do our best covering it up,
　it should work out somehow!」

stage0028_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$n
「Now we just need to finish cleaning up
　before $$大貫$$ wakes up and we're golden」

stage0028_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$アルト$$
「Right! Let's all work together
　and get this cleaned up fast!」

stage0028_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sousuke, you wake Tsubaki up,
　and get dinner ready, please」

stage0028_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll leave the menu to you.
　And no more duels with Tsubaki, got it?」

stage0028_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$宗介$$
「Only if he doesn't start it.」

stage0028_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Then I'll deal with $$ボン太くん#robot$$.」

stage0028_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Sorry, $$ヒイロ$$.
　You saved us today.」

stage0028_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$宗介$$
「Stay and eat dinner with everyone.」

stage0028_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$宗介$$
「Calorie Friend...
　The fruit kind, too...」

stage0028_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$デュオ$$
「$$ヒイロ$$ there, ever since he got some from you,
　seems like he's hooked on that flavor」

stage0028_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$宗介$$
「Could it be that you...
　helped me and the Volunteer Club because...」

stage0028_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Don't mention it.
　It's thanks for the fruit kind.」

stage0028_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$大貫$$
「Sagara, Tsubaki... why are you two here...?」

stage0028_03:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$大貫$$
「Ha! Don't tell me...!
　You mean to take my ripened body by force...?
　To savor the fruit about to fall from the branch?」

stage0028_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$宗介$$
「You seem to be under some misunderstanding...」

stage0028_03:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$一成$$
「Relax.
　We didn't come here to hurt you.」

stage0028_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$宗介$$
「The school cleaning is finished,
　so we came to bring you back, $$大貫$$.」

stage0028_03:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$カレン$$
「By cleaning the school ourselves,
　we came to really understand
　how hard you always work, $$大貫$$」

stage0028_03:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$さやか$$
「So today, as our thanks,
　please eat the dinner we made」

stage0028_03:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$大貫$$
「Twenty-five years as caretaker, and I...
　I have never been this moved!」

stage0028_03:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$大貫$$
「There is still kindness in this world...!
　Thank you! Thank you, all of you!」

stage0028_03:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$大貫$$
「No, I'm genuinely happy!
　Even Sagara and Tsubaki, who were brawling
　this afternoon, seem to have made up!」

stage0028_03:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$一成$$
（That's just because Chidori asked me to help...）

stage0028_03:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$宗介$$
（Stay quiet, unless you want to be knocked out again）

stage0028_03:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$クラン$$
「Come on, $$大貫$$!
　Let's eat before dinner gets cold!」

stage0028_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$アルト$$
「This is Japanese food I put my all into.
　Everyone, please dig in」

stage0028_03:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$カレン$$
「By the way, $$シンジ$$ made the miso soup.」

stage0028_03:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Seriously, $$シンジ$$!
　You've got quite the hidden talent!」

stage0028_03:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$n
「The fish simmered in miso $$大貫$$'s eating
　right now, $$宗介$$ and Tsubaki made it」

stage0028_03:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$大貫$$
「Mm, delicious.
　By the way, this is a taste I've never had,
　what kind of fish is this?」

stage0028_03:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Carp is an unknown taste, huh...
　I want to try it too」

stage0028_03:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You're way too close, $$ゼシカ$$...!」

stage0028_03:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'm joking, $$ミコノ$$.
　It's a fun dinner for once,
　so let's not pout, okay?」

stage0028_03:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$大貫$$
「...Sagara, Tsubaki...
　where did you get this carp?」

stage0028_03:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$宗介$$
「We caught it in the pond behind the school.」

stage0028_03:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$宗介$$
「And it thrashed around a lot.」

stage0028_03:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$一成$$
「Took some effort to kill it.」

stage0028_03:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Damn it!
　Didn't make it in time!」

stage0028_03:r_7d9f085a5d9c51fd.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Everyone, run!
　If you don't want to die, don't look back,
　just run with everything you've got!」

stage0028_03:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Jindai High's strongest man is about to wake up!」

stage0028_03:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$大貫$$
「Sagara, Tsubaki...
　that carp, you see...」

stage0028_03:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$大貫$$
「That carp, I spent fifteen years raising it
　with care... no, with the utmost care」

stage0028_03:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$大貫$$
「To me, it was like a grandchild...
　that's the kind of carp it was...」

stage0028_03:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$大貫$$
「Its name came from a famous French actress
　named 'Catherine'...」

stage0028_03:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$大貫$$
「You caught it?
　It took effort to kill?
　And on top of that, you fed it to me...!」

stage0028_03:r_69bf15620a355d50.text:
$$大貫$$
「Mm-hmm... this old man's got it figured out.
　Not a shred of passion or good will in it.
　All that's in you two is malice, I see...」

stage0028_03:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$大貫$$
「I must avenge my beloved Catherine...!」

stage0028_03:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$大貫$$
「Sorry, but you're both going to die...!
　Sagara, Tsubaki!」

stage0028_03:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$かなめ$$
「After we evacuated, all through the night
　the school building echoed with a chainsaw
　and Sousuke and Tsubaki's screams.」

stage0028_03:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Not knowing when the carnage would end,
　the neighbors spent all night trembling.」

stage0028_03:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「The wrecked school building was repaired
　thanks to $$ＭＩＸ$$'s desperate hard work, but
　the broken hearts won't ever mend.」

stage0028_03:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Once Mr. $$大貫$$ returned to normal at dawn,
　Sousuke and Tsubaki won't defy him again.」

stage0028_03:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Isn't there someone like that near you too?
　Always mild, and you've never seen them angry...」

stage0028_03:r_263097ee015a04ab.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But maybe it's exactly people like that
　who keep a savage beast inside their heart...」

stage0028_03:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text: ～ EFF Far East Branch, Director's Office ～

stage0028_03:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$レディ$$
「...Now, I'll announce the $$大統領$$'s decision.」

stage0028_03:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
$$レディ$$
「The new unit formed from $$プリベンター$$ is guaranteed
　the right to act anywhere, anytime, whenever it
　serves humanity's peace and progress.」

stage0028_03:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$レディ$$
「Personnel and equipment are left entirely
　to our discretion, and acting independent
　of the EFF chain of command is permitted.」

stage0028_03:r_54d7a668750123ea.text:
$$テッサ$$
「So our work is finally officially recognized.」

stage0028_03:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$オットー$$
「Having gained this moral backing
　is a fine thing indeed.」

stage0028_03:r_1d13d9bb6a6d7818.text:
$$レディ$$
「But the road ahead is difficult.」

stage0028_03:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Earth-colony conflict, $$マーティアル$$'s scheming,
　the Demon Emperor, the Angels, the Abductors...
　and the mystery enemy 'UG'...」

stage0028_03:r_9b8d839e83da7879.text:
$$大塚$$
「But the strength to break through that
　difficulty has gathered here. There is hope.」

stage0028_03:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Commander $$レディ・アン$$...
　Will we be calling ourselves $$プリベンター$$ from now on?」

stage0028_03:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$$レディ$$
「No...
　For the new independent unit, I'd like to
　use words a certain person left behind.」

stage0028_03:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$オットー$$
「And who might that person be...」

stage0028_03:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$レディ$$
「It's 《$$エルガン・ローディック$$》.」

stage0028_03:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The man captivated by 《$$黒の英知$$》,
　one of 《$$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$》...」

stage0028_03:r_cc01b694a39de719.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The one who wished for peace and progress
　in $$ＡＤＷ$$, and laid its cornerstone, right?」

stage0028_03:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$レディ$$
「After the $$再世戦争$$ ended, $$プリベンター$$
　traced Mr. Roddick's footsteps, and in doing
　so, we found these words of his.」

stage0028_03:r_fa54b106906131ec.text:
$$レディ$$
「'To protect this beautiful, blue star,
　I dearly wish that those who fight, crossing
　the Earth-space divide, would join hands.' ...」

stage0028_03:r_64f86b30363f1f4c.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I see...
　Those words sound just like him...」

stage0028_03:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$レディ$$
「And I added a 'Z' for unwavering resolve...」

stage0028_03:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text:
$$レディ$$
「Z Busters Link
　Universe & Earth...
　Its name: Z-BLUE （Zee-Blue）.」

stage0028_03:r_8b22d4b99ca35b84.text:
$$レディ$$
「If there are other opinions, I'd like to hear them.」

stage0028_03:r_b0aaf075b2a97a36.text:
$$レディ$$
「From this point on, we begin operating
　as '$c'.」

stage0028_03:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$...
　A unit that carries on their will while
　adding new comrades... So, $c, huh.」

stage0028_03:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$大塚$$
「I'm counting on you, $c.
　Fight for this blue star.」

stage0028_03:r_d3ea963a3518a978.text:
$$大塚$$
「Just what business brings you here?
　I wasn't told you'd be visiting.」

stage0028_03:r_0c888ad00ef30dc4.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Have you forgotten, Director $$大塚$$?
　That EFF Supreme Command holds the right
　to freely inspect every theater army.」

stage0028_03:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$$テッサ$$
（$$サイガス・エイロニー$$...
　The face of Earth supremacism within the EFF...）

stage0028_03:r_bee2bfb994ca7365.text:
$$オットー$$
（His nickname: the tail-end of $$ティターンズ$$,
　a leftover scrap of 《$$ロゴス$$》...
　They say he's always griping at Londo Bell too）

stage0028_03:r_6d287e4652a3781f.text:
$$大塚$$
「So then, Brig. Gen. $$サイガス$$...
　Supreme Command judged that this Far East
　Branch needs an inspection, is that it?」

stage0028_03:r_4d54e46ed7fd462d.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Not the Far East Branch itself.
　It's about the newly approved independent unit.」

stage0028_03:r_1c42d2bca3a5e3a3.text:
$$レディ$$
（Impossible...
　Has a direct order from the $$大統領$$
　already leaked to Supreme Command...?）

stage0028_03:r_b23f4e273f76c5a8.text:
$$サイガス$$
「What's wrong, $$レディ・アン$$?
　You don't look well.」

stage0028_03:r_6acc4cacd2cf56b6.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Since the $$大統領$$ approved it, Supreme
　Command won't interfere with its existence.」

stage0028_03:r_0491c741ae20f5e6.text:
$$サイガス$$
「But since you're outside the Federation's
　chain of command, if you act against the
　Earth Federation's interests, be prepared.」

stage0028_03:r_fc994d6aae0712cc.text:
$$サイガス$$
「It's a warning, Director $$大塚$$.」

stage0028_03:r_18ef8ab6be368d72.text:
$$サイガス$$
「The day of talks between the $$大統領$$
　and Neo Zeon's $$ハマーン$$ is coming soon.
　Until then, please refrain from acting alone.」

stage0028_03:r_176fd2544c64e83e.text:
$$レディ$$
「$$サイガス・エイロニー$$...
　Just how much backing does he have...」

stage0028_03:r_ae2ea53f43e74074.text:
$$大塚$$
「To apply pressure so openly...
　We'll need to be careful.」

stage0028_03:r_60e8a3284b8a113b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But our... $c's fight has begun.
　There's no turning back, no stopping now.」

stage0028_03:r_d4164c459c1c1165.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「That's right.
　This fog of malice covering the world...
　We must clear it away.」

stage0028_03:r_e745974656b70e6a.text:
$$レディ$$
「I've already reached out to sympathetic
　organizations and members for their help.」

stage0028_03:r_f794dabe545dc6ac.text:
$$レディ$$
「Once $c starts fighting,
　they'll surely join the fight too.」

stage0028_03:r_d4f3fe1e9bcf2590.text:
$$大塚$$
「There's anxiety, but there's hope too.
　I'll be counting on your hard fight.」

stage0028_03:r_f3ed55718d2364ba.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please don't be so wary of me.
　I... I get hurt, you know.」

stage0028_03:r_47fd2ac2e2a8e945.text:
$$カレン$$
「S-sorry... But there's something about you
　I just can't let my guard down around...」

stage0028_03:r_95ef381ed0b96982.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh no...!
　And I prepared a present for Master $$カレン$$ today!」

stage0028_03:r_c4e4b578079583c5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah well, Master $$カレン$$'s fury in that battle
　with the harassing superior made a fine Z-Chip.」

stage0028_03:r_46c21ad643c64977.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's worth 100 Z!
　I'll add it to the unit's stock.」

stage0028_03:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
$$カレン$$
「Never mind that, what's with this bunny suit!?」

stage0028_03:r_04169fb070591784.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I thought that if you fought while
　wearing it, you might keep generating
　more Z-Chips going forward...」

stage0028_03:r_1be6bea3e5d25074.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And if teenage boys happened to see it
　and generate some Z-Chips too...」

stage0028_03:r_2471e14c1ef0ecac.text:
$$カレン$$
「No way!
　Your harassment's worse than $$カン・ユー$$'s!」

stage0028_03:r_9f5a27f5febf371b.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I see...
　And here I thought it was such a good idea.」

stage0028_03:r_c5d536c5ba8c0902.text:
$$カレン$$
「You were in on this too, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$!」

stage0028_03:r_243595675818fcae.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Don't get so mad.
　A bunny needs some charm to pull it off.」

stage0028_03:r_b267a0ec877acc0e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, $$ボン太くん#robot$$'s popular with all ages,
　but what exactly makes him so charming...」

stage0028_03:r_c627120a60cde94d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've got the same warm-toned, roundish body,
　yet somehow I just don't do well with the ladies.」

stage0028_03:r_22a2d3667e5a9fc8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Maybe I should add a distinctive verbal
　tic or something, to make my appeal clearer...」

stage0028_03:r_62e68b17a29fb53b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Or should I lean harder into the mascot-
　suit look, to seem more approachable...」

stage0028_03:r_3f09ae47d355cbc5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At the very least, I think I'm cuter than
　some stone-faced guy showing up...」

stage0028_03:r_629b0e87b7bc7b76.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Anyway, enough silly talk,
　let's get down to business!
　So today too, let's go... Business, business!」
